label: RetroArch manager
description: Detects an installed RetroArch, launches it with a chosen core/content via its own documented Intent extras, downloads cores from buildbot.libretro.com, and (with a root helper plugin you allow) puts them into RetroArch's own cores folder. Its Quick Menu panel shows RetroArch's status, the cores for your systems and the install action. See DESIGN.md for the source citations behind every claim this plugin makes.

permissions.reason: Finds out which RetroArch you have installed
Starts RetroArch with the core and game you chose
Downloads cores from libretro's build server
Puts a downloaded core into RetroArch's own cores folder, which only root can reach. Optional: without it you install the core from RetroArch itself.

requires.reason: Puts a downloaded core into RetroArch's own cores folder
